data.description:
## Goal
Stop the agent-created skill/shared symlink from dirtying the main checkout and tripping the implement skill dirty-tree gate. The symlink is created by skill bootstrap scripts and is untracked.

## Acceptance Criteria
- skill/shared (or equivalent) is added to the repository .gitignore so it is expected-dirty on all checkouts.
- The implement dirty-tree gate no longer blocks on the symlink.
- The symlink itself is never deleted or committed.

data.description:
## Failure Signature

- Test file: packages/herdr/src/worklist-blocked-by-cache.test.ts (2 failing tests)
  1. `Blocked By flicker fix (WL-0MV8Q5X8U004KKAP) > fail-open: a rejected lookup yields no rows and never breaks rendering` — `expected ' Work Items — 2 item(s)…' not to contain 'Blocked By'` (a Blocked By row is rendered after the fail-open lookup rejection).
  2. `detail-view Blocked By parity (WL-0MVBMLY2Z0032CYR) > the detail view renders Blocked By rows with status through the shared single-flight lookup` — `expected ' Work Items — 2 item(s)…' to contain 'WL-BLOCKED'` (no Blocked By row rendered in this path).
- Baseline: **PRE-EXISTING at dev HEAD eb1f2e91** — reproduced with the work item's changes stashed (clean tree), so not caused by WL-0MVFE1AB0002PEPN.
- Not in the configured full-suite gate (`.pi/test-config.json` suiteCommands = tests/cli + tests/unit): surfaced only when the packages/herdr suite is run explicitly.

## Evidence

```
Test Files  2 failed | 1 passed (3)
Tests       3 failed | 45 passed (48)
```

(3rd failure in that run was worklist-agent-state-event.test.ts, tracked separately; db-change.test.ts flaked once and passed on rerun.)

## Steps To Reproduce

1. `git checkout eb1f2e91` (dev HEAD at filing time)
2. `npm --silent test -- packages/herdr/src/worklist-blocked-by-cache.test.ts`

## Impact

The packages/herdr suite is red, so any herdr-package work item that runs the herdr suite explicitly (as this epic's items do) sees a failing gate it did not cause.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Both listed tests pass against latest dev.
2. No unrelated test is weakened to make them pass.

Discovered-from:WL-0MVFE1AB0002PEPN
